body:
AUTHORIZED BY MYK 2026-09-05: Continue autonomously, build the previously proposed pure projection proof, resolve routine choices without ceremony. This is a bounded first implementation slice of T280, not full section60 or production integration.

CONTRACT. Add an internal pure live receiving-law projector in src/gateway/receive-policy.ts. Explicit signed receiver relationship decisions select source incarnation/identity, source author, hyperschema entity/reading, destination and local name. Effective law derives from verified source registration/definition deltas and current lawful receiver-local curses. Live revisions, retractions and retractions of retractions need no receiver signer or newly minted adoption. Original authorship remains. Source input sets and recipient decision sets remain separate even when their signer is the same. Reuse existing lawful registration resolution rather than invent a new negation or version algorithm. Replaying the identical available claim set in different orders with duplicates yields identical effective outputs. Malformed/tampered/unknown source decisions fail closed with explicit diagnostics; no omitted context defaults to primary or operator. Executable resolvers are withheld.

BOUNDARY. No HTTP/MCP/Gateway wiring, package export, storage migration, existing test modification, new general-purpose event system or separate repository. The module may construct in-memory Reactors as a bounded reference proof; it is not a production-scale indexed receiving engine. The first slice supports live declarative law selection only. One-time/pause snapshots, nested dependency evaluation, general policy inheritance, re-export and physical lifecycle remain later contracts. Unsupported modes/shapes must refuse honestly rather than silently approximate. The returned law can be evaluated over explicit caller-selected destination data in a real substrate test, demonstrating all relevant source/local data participates and excluded root data does not.

RAILS FIRST. Write test/gateway/receive-policy.test.ts, measure on base (module absent) honestly as feature absence, and separately measure substantive assertions against a nonfunctional stub before implementing. Record actual case counts and label controls. Declare rails only after the file exists and measurement; freeze then implement, with reported defects rather than casual test edits. Use real signed claims and real resolution, not mocks of authority. Run focused tests, lint/format/typecheck, full npm run check, frozen-rail guard, scoped mutation checks and independent review. No gate result is inferred from prose.

Acceptance criteria:
1. A valid signed receiving relationship yields the selected source reading and its source-bound identity; two sources sharing a signer remain distinguished by source context. Verify: test/gateway/receive-policy.test.ts.
2. A newer valid source registration changes effective law; its lawful negation exposes the prior survivor; negating the strike restores it. A stranger strike does nothing. No receiver signing is available to the projector. Verify: same file, exact registration IDs and real resolved values.
3. A receiver curse hides the selected law without removing source deltas; lawful lift restores eligibility; foreign curse/lift cannot authorize change. Verify: same file, source bytes/IDs unchanged and served object behavior.
4. Permuted and duplicate input replays return identical effective metadata and values, including same-author distinct sources and receiver decisions. Verify: same file.
5. Invalid signatures/content IDs, malformed/ambiguous decisions, missing source and unsupported modes/dependency shapes fail closed explicitly. Verify: same file, two-sided accepted controls.
6. Projected law resolves matching data from multiple sources and local data within the supplied destination scope; an excluded primary decoy never appears. Resolver code is withheld, not executed. Verify: same file using rhizomatic materialization/resolution.
7. Existing production behavior and frozen rails remain untouched. Verify: npm run check, node scripts/rails-guard-ci.mjs origin/main, and git diff of existing src/test paths.

P1 scope: this bounded contract is authorized by the user; T280 broader export/alias questions do not block this pure proof. P2 is a single independent slice with no integration dependency; T280's future input-isolation contract is required before this projector is wired to same-store ingress. Do not mark T280 or T263 complete when this proof passes.

P1 CONTRACT REVIEW: Trusted input construction must supply distinct source-context member sets; this proof does not authenticate physical container membership. Receiver decisions can come only from the supplied recipient decision set, never from source inputs even with same signer. Reject ambiguous source IDs and verify each presented delta before deduplication. Select authoritative source revision before rejecting unsupported dependency shapes. Withheld resolver field names must be explicit; returned metadata is not a ready-to-serve Gateway registration and the later serving adapter must refuse those fields rather than silently substitute fallback semantics. Supplemental test/gateway/receive-policy-boundaries.test.ts owns the identified missing coverage: actual value changes across revisions, distinct valid same-author sources, source-only authority records, duplicate tampering and named withheld fields.

RAIL MEASUREMENT: test/gateway/receive-policy.test.ts initially failed collection on base because feature module did not exist (0 executed, not a behavioral red claim). Corrected pre-freeze fixture API mistakes; a nonfunctional [] projection measured 5 behavioral failures. Supplemental rail measured real gaps in named resolver withholding and conflict replay metadata; 2 controls passed/1 failed in first pass, and 3 controls passed/1 failed for conflict permutation before repair. Logs /tmp/loam-t281-stub-corrected.log, /tmp/loam-t281-supplement-red.log, /tmp/loam-t281-conflict-red.log. Source scope and data membership authentication remain caller responsibilities, not properties established by this pure selection module. Local name is the selected reading in this initial profile; renaming/source incarnation lifecycle adapters are not implemented.

REVIEW CORRECTIONS: Independent code review and independent verification found malformed roots admitted into a selected candidate and a signed prototype-named resolver lost by the legacy parser. Both findings were recorded before repair. Supplemental regressions measured 2 failures with 8 accepted controls before fixes. Mutation-derived signed envelope cases cover extra pointers, wrong marker IDs, and entity payloads carrying extra values ignored by canonical encoding. These are authorized rail-defect corrections, not revisions of existing base rails. Log: /tmp/loam-t281-review-red.log. The complete first mutation run measured 15 killed/5 surviving; later results remain separately recorded, never substituted for this result.
title: Prove live receiving-law projection without receiver signing
